verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that ReadMe has an official CLI, rdme, documented in the readmeio GitHub repo. That covers the core of the story, but the pack gives almost nothing beyond its existence. Related programmatic and Git-based workflows (the ReadMe API, docs run through Git) add context but are not the CLI itself. Missing for 10: details of the CLI's commands and capabilities, evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
